title: 雪梨歌劇院~Sydney Opera House
focus: 以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱、環氧接縫與後拉預力，把自由造型的帆形屋殼變成可製造、可架設的結構~Precast rib arches cut from one sphere, epoxy joints and post-tensioning that turned free-form sails into a buildable structure
summary: 從烏戎競圖中無法計算的帆形輪廓出發，說明 Arup 如何以半徑約 75 m 的共同球面把屋殼改為預鑄肋拱，再處理肋段斷面、環氧膠結與後拉預力、伸縮式架設拱與逐段吊裝、電腦化幾何控制，以及風洞與結構模型驗證。最後談海港環境中瓷磚蓋板扣件、預力與混凝土的耐久，以及世界遺產建築的檢測與交接紀錄。~Starting from Utzon's competition sails that could not be calculated, the course shows how Arup turned the shells into precast rib arches cut from a common sphere of about 75 m radius, then covers rib sections, epoxy bonding and post-tensioning, telescopic erection arches and segment-by-segment lifting, computerised geometry control, and wind-tunnel and structural-model verification. It ends with the durability of tile-lid fixings, prestress and concrete in a harbour environment and the inspection and handover records of a World Heritage building.

units.anchor: 75 m 共同球面~Common 75 m sphere
units.title: 從自由曲面到球面解~From free-form sails to the spherical solution
units.mechanism: 烏戎 1957 年的競圖草圖只有帆形輪廓，沒有可計算的幾何定義；高聳陡峭的殼體在風與自重下以彎矩為主，無法像低矮薄殼那樣只靠膜力傳遞荷載。設計團隊在 1957 至 1961 年間試過拋物線、橢圓等至少 12 種方案，最後把所有主殼外表面都取自同一個半徑約 75 m 的球面，讓殼片改由一束束從台座輻射而出的預鑄肋拱組成。共同曲率意味著距台座相同弧長的肋段斷面相同，可以用少數標準模具重複生產，幾何問題因此轉成工業化生產問題。~Utzon's 1957 competition sketches gave sail outlines but no computable geometry; tall, steep shells under wind and self-weight are dominated by bending and cannot carry load by membrane action alone like shallow thin shells. Between 1957 and 1961 the team tried at least 12 schemes, including parabolic and ellipsoidal ones, before taking every main shell surface from one sphere of about 75 m radius, so each shell became a fan of precast rib arches radiating from a pedestal. Common curvature means rib segments at the same arc distance from the pedestal share one cross-section and can be produced repeatedly in a few standard moulds, turning a geometry problem into an industrial production problem.
units.model: 肋線是通過台座極點的大圓，相鄰兩肋夾角 Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad 時，距極點弧長 s 處的肋間距 w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ。取 R = 75 m：s = 10 m 時 w ≈ 0.64 m；s = 64 m 時 s/R = 0.853 rad、sin = 0.754，w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m，肋段因此越往脊線越寬。R 與 3.65° 取自 Arup 公開資料，弧長取值為教學近似。~Ribs are great circles through a pole at the pedestal; with an angle Δφ = 3.65° = 0.0637 rad between adjacent ribs, the spacing at arc distance s from the pole is w = R·sin(s/R)·Δφ. With R = 75 m: at s = 10 m, w ≈ 0.64 m; at s = 64 m, s/R = 0.853 rad, sin = 0.754 and w = 75×0.754×0.0637 ≈ 3.6 m, so segments widen toward the ridge. R and 3.65° are from Arup's published account; the arc distances are teaching approximations.
units.verify: 以三維座標把每條肋線的球心、極點與大圓平面寫成方程，抽查肋段四角座標是否落在 75 m 球面上（徑向偏差以毫米計），並確認相同弧長位置的肋段斷面在各殼片間確實可共用模具；1960 年代以電腦程式與幾何模型交互核對，今日則以參數化模型與點雲比對完成同樣的檢查。~Write each rib line as an equation defined by the sphere centre, the pole and its great-circle plane, spot-check that the corner coordinates of rib segments lie on the 75 m sphere with radial deviations in millimetres, and confirm that segments at equal arc distance really can share moulds across shells; in the 1960s this was cross-checked between computer programs and geometric models, today the same check is done with a parametric model and point-cloud comparison.
units.failure: 沒有幾何定義就無法計算內力與製作模板：曲面未定案時若照每個殼片各自曲率現場澆鑄，模板成本與工期會失控，殼片之間的脊線也無法保證吻合。雪梨歌劇院的台座在屋頂方案定案前已開工，後來台座柱因無法承受最終屋頂荷載而必須重建，正是設計與施工順序倒置的代價。~Without a defined geometry, internal forces cannot be calculated and formwork cannot be made: casting each shell in place to its own curvature before the surface is fixed would let formwork cost and programme run out of control and leave ridge lines between shells unmatched. At Sydney the podium started before the roof scheme was settled, and its columns later had to be rebuilt because they could not carry the final roof loads, the price of reversing design and construction order.
units.misconception: 雪梨歌劇院的屋殼是像蛋殼一樣只靠膜力的薄殼。~The Sydney Opera House roofs are eggshell-like thin shells working only by membrane action.
units.practice: 曲面造型先要有可以寫成方程的幾何母體，再談分割、模具與施工；幾何凍結前不應讓承受屋頂反力的下部結構開工，或至少在合約中保留重新設計台座與基礎的條款。~A curved form first needs a geometric parent that can be written as an equation, before segmentation, moulds and construction are discussed; substructures carrying roof reactions should not start before the geometry is frozen, or the contract should at least reserve the right to redesign pedestals and foundations.

units.anchor: 肋拱台座反力~Rib pedestal reactions
units.title: 自重、溫差與成對肋拱的傳力~Self-weight, temperature and paired-rib load path
units.mechanism: 每片主殼由左右兩組肋拱扇面組成，肋拱從混凝土台座起拱，向上延伸到脊梁與對向的肋相接，主要以拱作用把自重壓力傳回台座；左右成對的肋在殼片對稱面上互相平衡水平推力，剩餘反力由台座、下方柱與基礎承擔。台座把所有預鑄段匯集到共同起拱點，因此台座與其下柱的剛度直接決定殼片變形。暴露在雪梨陽光下的外側肋與室內側肋溫差可達十多度，受約束時會產生明顯附加應力，是自重以外不可忽略的荷載。~Each main shell is two mirrored fans of rib arches that spring from concrete pedestals and rise to a ridge beam where they meet the opposing ribs, carrying self-weight mainly by arch action in compression back to the pedestals. Paired ribs balance each other's horizontal thrust across the shell's plane of symmetry, and the remaining reactions go to the pedestals, the columns below and the foundations. The pedestal gathers every precast segment to a common springing point, so its stiffness and that of the columns beneath directly govern shell deformation. Exposed outer ribs in Sydney sunshine can be more than ten degrees warmer than inner ribs, which produces significant additional stress when restrained, a load that cannot be ignored beside self-weight.
units.model: Arup 公開的夏季設計溫度為外側肋 43°C、內側肋 27°C，溫差 ΔT = 16°C。取 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C，自由應變 ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶，64 m 弧長的自由伸長差 ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm；若完全受約束、E = 30,000 MPa，應力 σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa。α、E 與完全約束為教學假設。~Arup's published summer design temperatures are 43°C for external ribs and 27°C for internal ribs, a difference ΔT = 16°C. With α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C the free strain is ε = αΔT = 160×10⁻⁶ and the free length difference over a 64 m arc is ΔL = 160×10⁻⁶×64,000 mm ≈ 10 mm; fully restrained with E = 30,000 MPa, the stress would be σ = E·αΔT ≈ 4.8 MPa. α, E and full restraint are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在結構模型中分別施加自重、風與溫差荷載組合，檢查肋拱每一斷面的軸力偏心是否落在斷面核心內或由預力涵蓋；以台座下柱的反力分配核對柱與基礎容量，並在施工中量測柱頂沉陷與肋拱溫度，公開資料記錄主屋頂柱最大沉陷約 3 mm，可作為比較基準。~Apply self-weight, wind and temperature combinations separately in the structural model and check at each rib section whether the axial-force eccentricity stays within the section core or is covered by prestress; check the reaction distribution under the pedestals against column and foundation capacity, and during construction measure column-head settlement and rib temperatures, the published maximum settlement of about 3 mm for the main roof columns being a useful benchmark.
units.failure: 若只用自重推力線設計肋拱而忽略外側肋日照升溫，受約束的肋在脊梁與台座附近會出現額外彎矩，接縫張開、預力損失增加；若台座下柱剛度與假設不同，殼片會不對稱下沉，脊線附近的接縫承受設計範圍外的剪力。~Designing the ribs only for the self-weight thrust line and ignoring solar heating of the outer ribs gives restrained ribs extra bending near the ridge beam and pedestals, opening joints and increasing prestress losses; if the columns under the pedestals differ in stiffness from the assumption, the shells settle unevenly and joints near the ridge carry shear outside the design envelope.
units.misconception: 混凝土殼體屋頂只需要考慮自重與風，溫度影響可以忽略。~A concrete shell roof only needs self-weight and wind; temperature effects can be ignored.
units.practice: 曲面屋頂的荷載組合表要單列日照溫差與季節溫差，並寫明所採用的外表面與內側設計溫度；台座與下部柱的勁度假設須寫入計算書，施工後以實測沉陷校核。~The load-combination table of a curved roof should list solar and seasonal temperature differences separately and state the external and internal design temperatures used; stiffness assumptions for pedestals and supporting columns should be written into the calculations and checked against measured settlement after construction.

units.anchor: 預鑄肋段與標準模具~Precast rib segments and moulds
units.title: 肋段斷面與現場預鑄工廠~Rib-segment sections and the on-site casting yard
units.mechanism: 肋段在台座附近是實心 T 形，往上變為實心 Y 形，再往上成為開口 Y 形；斷面隨彎矩與軸力減小而變薄，但外表面始終貼合球面，翼緣直接成為屋面蓋板的支承。所有肋段都在現場預鑄工廠以可調模具生產，標準段長約 4.6 m、最重約 10 t，長度與重量由塔吊能力反推。預鑄讓混凝土在受控環境中養護，強度、尺寸與表面品質比高空現場澆置穩定，接縫面也能先研磨處理以利後續膠結。~Rib segments are solid T-sections near the pedestal, solid Y-sections higher up and open Y-sections near the top; the section thins as bending and axial force reduce, yet its outer face always follows the sphere and its flanges directly support the roof tile lids. All segments were produced in an on-site precasting yard with adjustable moulds; a standard segment is about 4.6 m long and weighs up to about 10 t, length and weight being derived back from tower-crane capacity. Precasting lets the concrete cure under controlled conditions, so strength, dimensions and surface quality are more consistent than casting at height, and joint faces can be ground beforehand for bonding.
units.model: 標準段重約 10,160 kg、長 4.6 m（Arup 公開資料）。取鋼筋混凝土密度 2,450 kg/m³，體積 V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³，平均斷面積 A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²；若某段改用實心斷面使面積增加 20%，重量升到約 12.2 t，就超出塔吊在 30.5 m 半徑的能力。密度與 20% 增量為教學假設。~A standard segment weighs about 10,160 kg and is 4.6 m long (Arup's published data). With a reinforced-concrete density of 2,450 kg/m³ the volume is V = 10,160/2,450 ≈ 4.15 m³ and the mean section area A = 4.15/4.6 ≈ 0.90 m²; making a segment solid with 20% more area would raise its weight to about 12.2 t, beyond the cranes' capacity at a 30.5 m radius. Density and the 20% increase are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個肋段出模後量測長度、端面角度與外表面曲率，以樣板或座標量測確認誤差在接縫可吸收範圍內；混凝土以立方試體驗收，公開資料列出最低立方強度 41 與 52 N/mm² 兩級，並記錄每段的澆置日期與實測重量，作為吊裝與加載齡期排程的依據。~After demoulding, measure each segment's length, end-face angles and outer-surface curvature with templates or coordinate survey to confirm deviations within what the joints can absorb; accept concrete by cube tests, the published minimum cube strengths being 41 and 52 N/mm² grades, and record each segment's casting date and measured weight to plan lifting and age at loading.
units.failure: 端面角度誤差會在一條十多段的肋上累積，使肋頂偏離脊線；斷面若因模具變形而超重，吊裝時會接近或超過塔吊額定，或使預定的預力不足以閉合接縫。混凝土齡期太短就承受預力與吊裝，徐變增加會讓肋拱長期下垂。~End-face angle errors accumulate along a rib of a dozen segments and push its tip off the ridge line; a segment that is overweight because of mould distortion approaches or exceeds the crane rating during lifting, or leaves the planned prestress unable to close the joints. Segments loaded by prestress and lifting at too young an age creep more, and the rib sags over time.
units.misconception: 預鑄肋段只要外觀尺寸正確，重量與齡期不影響架設。~As long as a precast rib segment has the right dimensions, its weight and age do not affect erection.
units.practice: 預鑄工廠應建立一段一卡：模具編號、澆置日期、立方強度、實測重量、端面量測與最早允許吊裝日期；未達齡期或量測不合格的段不得進入吊裝序列，須由現場工程師簽放。~The casting yard should keep one card per segment: mould number, casting date, cube strength, measured weight, end-face survey and earliest permitted lifting date; segments below age or out of tolerance must not enter the lifting sequence until released by the site engineer.

units.anchor: 環氧接縫與預力鋼絞線~Epoxy joints and prestressing strand
units.title: 接縫膠結與後拉預力~Joint bonding and post-tensioning
units.mechanism: 肋段之間以環氧樹脂膠結，接縫厚度只有約 0.8 至 3 mm，再以穿過肋段孔道的 15.2 mm 鋼絞線後拉，把一段段預鑄件串成連續肋拱。膠在硬化期間必須受壓，因此每吊上一段就先施加臨時預力，使接縫閉合並能傳遞剪力；完成後的永久預力讓肋拱在風吸力與溫差下仍保持接縫受壓。孔道灌漿保護鋼絞線免於腐蝕，也讓鋼絞線與混凝土共同作用。~Segments were bonded with epoxy in joints only about 0.8 to 3 mm thick and post-tensioned with 15.2 mm strand through ducts in the segments, turning individual precast pieces into continuous rib arches. The epoxy must be under compression while it cures, so each newly placed segment was stressed temporarily to close the joint and transfer shear; the permanent prestress then keeps every joint in compression under wind suction and temperature difference. Duct grouting protects the strand against corrosion and makes strand and concrete act together.
units.model: 某接縫以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根面積 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa，總力 P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN；接縫面積 0.90 m² 時平均預壓 σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa。若損失使有效應力降為 1,000 MPa，預壓降至約 1.1 MPa。鋼絞線數量與應力為教學假設。~A joint stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² each at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa receives P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN; over a 0.90 m² joint the mean precompression is σ = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.3 MPa. If losses reduce the effective stress to 1,000 MPa, the precompression falls to about 1.1 MPa. Strand count and stress are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 接縫面須在膠結前研磨露出骨材，事後研究建議研磨後 7 天內完成膠結，施膠後在規定時間內施加臨時預力；以千斤頂壓力與伸長量雙重控制每次張拉，兩者偏差超過約 5% 時暫停查明原因；灌漿以流動度、泌水試驗與每個排氣口出漿確認孔道充滿。~Joint faces must be ground to expose aggregate before bonding, later research recommending bonding within 7 days of grinding, and temporary prestress applied within the specified time after the epoxy is placed; control every stressing operation by both jack pressure and elongation, pausing to investigate when they differ by more than about 5%; confirm grouting by flow-cone and bleed tests and by grout emerging at every vent.
units.failure: 膠層在未受壓時硬化會形成空隙與弱面，之後在反覆風吸力下接縫張開；孔道灌漿不密實會讓海風帶來的氯離子腐蝕鋼絞線，預力在不被察覺的情況下逐年流失，這類隱藏性劣化是預力殼體最難檢測的風險。~Epoxy that cures without compression leaves voids and weak planes, and joints then open under repeated wind suction; incomplete duct grouting lets chlorides carried by sea air corrode the strand so prestress is lost year by year without notice, a hidden deterioration that is the hardest risk to detect in a prestressed shell.
units.misconception: 環氧樹脂黏得夠牢，肋段之間不需要預力也能形成連續拱。~Epoxy bonds strongly enough that rib segments form a continuous arch without prestress.
units.practice: 張拉紀錄要逐束保存（千斤頂編號、校正日期、壓力、伸長、鎖定損失），灌漿紀錄要能對應到每一個孔道；Arup 1973 年的公開回顧把孔道灌漿與結構膠結各寫成專文，交接時應把這類程序文件列為必要附件。~Keep stressing records tendon by tendon (jack number, calibration date, pressure, elongation, lock-off loss) and grouting records traceable to each duct; Arup's 1973 published review devoted separate papers to duct grouting and structural adhesives, and such procedure records should be mandatory attachments at handover.

units.anchor: 伸縮式鋼構架設拱~Telescopic steel erection arch
units.title: 架設拱與逐段吊裝~Erection arch and segment-by-segment lifting
units.mechanism: 肋拱在與對向肋於脊梁相接之前是不穩定的懸伸構件，因此承包商 Hornibrook 設計了圓弧形、可伸縮調整的鋼構架設拱，在殼片下方承托新吊上的肋段。每段由塔吊吊到定位、塗膠、施加臨時預力後，架設拱繼續承托直到該肋完成並與脊梁連接，再以油壓缸把架設拱移到下一條肋。球面的共同曲率讓同一組架設拱只要調整長度與角度就能服務所有肋，這是球面解在施工上的第二個紅利。~Until it meets the opposing ribs at the ridge beam, a rib is an unstable cantilever, so the contractor Hornibrook designed circular, telescopically adjustable steel erection arches to support newly lifted segments from beneath the shell. Each segment was craned into place, glued and temporarily stressed while the erection arch held it until the rib was complete and connected to the ridge beam; hydraulic rams then moved the arch to the next rib. Because every rib shares the sphere's curvature, the same erection arches served all ribs with only length and angle adjustments, a second construction dividend of the spherical solution.
units.model: 塔吊能力以力矩表示：最重肋段 W ≈ 10.16 t 在半徑 r = 30.5 m 時，需要 M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m，與公開資料中三台約 300 t·m 級的塔吊相當。若把肋段加長到 5.5 m，重量按比例增為 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t，需求升到約 370 t·m，超出塔吊能力，可見肋段長度是由吊裝能力反推。比例換算為教學推論。~Tower-crane capacity is a moment rating: the heaviest segment, W ≈ 10.16 t at a radius r = 30.5 m, needs M = W·r = 10.16×30.5 ≈ 310 t·m, matching the three tower cranes of about 300 t·m class in the published record. Lengthening segments to 5.5 m would raise their weight proportionally to 10.16×5.5/4.6 ≈ 12.1 t and the demand to about 370 t·m, beyond the cranes, showing that segment length was derived from lifting capacity. The proportional scaling is a teaching inference.
units.verify: 架設拱本身要依最不利的承托段數與位置做強度與穩定檢核，每次移位後量測其標高與角度；每吊一段都核對吊重、半徑與塔吊荷重表，並以測量確認肋段落位後的三維座標，才允許施加臨時預力。~Check the erection arch itself for strength and stability under the most adverse number and position of supported segments and survey its level and angle after every move; for every lift check weight and radius against the crane load chart, and confirm the placed segment's three-dimensional position by survey before temporary stressing is allowed.
units.failure: 架設拱移位太早，尚未與脊梁連接的肋會成為懸臂而下垂甚至傾覆；臨時預力不足時，接縫在膠未硬化前受彎張開，形成永久幾何偏差。吊裝時風速升高使肋段擺盪撞擊已安裝段，也是曲面預鑄架設常見的損傷來源。~Moving the erection arch too early leaves a rib not yet connected to the ridge as a cantilever that sags or even overturns; insufficient temporary prestress lets joints open in bending before the epoxy hardens, locking in a permanent geometric error. Rising wind during lifting can swing a segment into already placed ones, a common source of damage in curved precast erection.
units.misconception: 肋段吊上去塗好膠就能自行站立，架設拱只是保險。~A lifted segment stands on its own once glued, so the erection arch is only a precaution.
units.practice: 施工計畫應明訂架設拱的卸載條件：該肋全部段落位、臨時預力完成、與脊梁連接並經測量確認；吊裝作業設風速停止門檻，由吊裝負責人與結構工程師共同簽認，這些是停止點，不是操作許可。~The construction plan should state the release conditions for each erection arch: all segments of that rib placed, temporary prestress complete, ridge connection made and confirmed by survey; lifting should have a wind-speed stop limit jointly signed by the lifting supervisor and the structural engineer, and these are hold points, not operating permits.

units.anchor: 架設幾何測量網~Erection survey network
units.title: 電腦化測量與殼片幾何控制~Computerised survey and shell geometry control
units.mechanism: 每條肋拱由十多段接續而成，前段的微小角度誤差會在肋頂放大，而脊梁與蓋板又要求各肋位置互相吻合，因此架設期間需要持續的幾何控制。當年以電腦化測量系統追蹤殼片形狀，架設程序也用電腦程式檢核，計算需求大到必須借用南澳武器研究所的電腦。施工延誤使相鄰肋齡期不同，徐變差異被換算為等效溫差納入架設分析，是早期施工階段分析的實例。~Each rib is a chain of a dozen or more segments, so a small angular error in an early segment is magnified at the rib tip, while the ridge beams and tile lids require ribs to match each other; continuous geometric control during erection was therefore essential. A computerised survey system tracked shell shape, and the erection procedure was checked by computer programs whose demands required a computer at the Weapons Research Establishment in South Australia. Delays gave adjacent ribs different ages, and the resulting creep differences were converted into an equivalent temperature difference in the erection analysis, an early example of construction-stage analysis.
units.model: 起拱段角度誤差 Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad 時，64 m 弧長外的肋頂偏差約 δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm，遠超過 3 mm 級膠結接縫可吸收的量。公開資料把兩個月架設延遲造成的徐變，當作最後 4 條肋降溫 10°C 處理；以 α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C 換算，等效應變約 100×10⁻⁶。角度誤差與 α 為教學假設。~An angular error Δθ = 0.1° = 0.001745 rad at the springing segment displaces the rib tip 64 m away by about δ = s·Δθ = 64,000×0.001745 ≈ 112 mm, far beyond what 3 mm epoxy joints can absorb. The published record treated creep from a two-month erection delay as a 10°C temperature drop across the last four ribs; with α = 10×10⁻⁶ /°C that equals a strain of about 100×10⁻⁶. The angular error and α are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 從固定控制點以經緯儀或全測站量測每段落位後的特徵點，與電腦計算的理論座標比較；偏差超過允許值時以接縫墊片或臨時預力修正，不讓誤差帶到下一段。每條肋完成後再量測肋頂與脊梁接點，並把結果回饋到下一條肋的預設偏移量。~From fixed control points, survey target points on each placed segment with theodolite or total station and compare with computed theoretical coordinates; when deviation exceeds the allowance, correct with joint shims or temporary prestress rather than carrying it into the next segment. After each rib, survey its tip and ridge connection and feed the result back into the preset offsets of the next rib.
units.failure: 只在整條肋完成後才量測，累積誤差已無法修正，脊梁接點只能以大量現場澆置混凝土填補，改變原本的受力路徑；不同齡期肋段的徐變差若未納入分析，殼片完成後會出現不對稱下垂與脊線扭曲。~Surveying only after a whole rib is complete leaves accumulated error uncorrectable, and the ridge connection has to be filled with substantial in-situ concrete that changes the intended load path; if creep differences between segments of different ages are not analysed, the finished shell sags asymmetrically and the ridge line twists.
units.misconception: 預鑄件在工廠做得準，架設時就不需要逐段量測。~If precast pieces are made accurately, they need no segment-by-segment survey during erection.
units.practice: 每片殼都應有架設幾何控制表：理論座標、預設偏移、實測值與修正措施，由測量員與結構工程師逐段簽認；施工延誤超過設計假設的天數時，要通知設計者重算徐變影響後才繼續架設。~Each shell should have an erection geometry control sheet with theoretical coordinates, preset offsets, measured values and corrective actions, signed segment by segment by the surveyor and structural engineer; when delays exceed the days assumed in design, the designer must recalculate creep effects before erection continues.

units.title: 風洞試驗與阻塞效應~Wind-tunnel testing and blockage
units.mechanism: 陡峭的球面殼在背風側與脊線附近產生強烈分離流，吸力遠大於迎風壓力，規範的簡單體形係數無法涵蓋。設計團隊先在南安普敦大學以 1:100 實心木模型試驗，再到英國國家物理實驗室以 2.74 m × 2.13 m 的開放射流風洞重做較關鍵的殼片；比較顯示小風洞量到的背風吸力偏高，原因可能是模型佔風洞斷面比例過大的阻塞效應。這是把風洞試驗用於曲面屋頂設計的重要早期案例。~Steep spherical shells generate strong separated flow on the leeward side and near the ridge, with suctions far larger than windward pressure, which simple code shape factors cannot cover. The team first tested a 1:100 solid wooden model at the University of Southampton, then repeated the more critical shell at the National Physical Laboratory in a 2.74 m × 2.13 m open-jet tunnel; comparison showed higher leeward suctions in the small tunnel, probably because the model occupied too much of the tunnel cross-section, a blockage effect. It is an important early case of wind-tunnel testing for a curved roof design.
units.model: 設計風速 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s，停滯壓力 q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa；公開資料記錄背風脊最大吸力達 3.5q，約 4.3 kPa。阻塞比 = 模型迎風面積 / 風洞斷面：1:100 模型迎風面積若為 0.40 m²，在 5.84 m² 的射流斷面中約佔 6.8%，在 1.5 m² 的小風洞則約佔 27%。迎風面積與小風洞斷面為教學假設。~The design wind speed 161 km/h = 44.7 m/s gives a stagnation pressure q = ½ρV² = 0.5×1.225×44.7² ≈ 1.22 kPa; the published maximum leeward ridge suction of 3.5q is about 4.3 kPa. Blockage ratio = model frontal area / tunnel section: a 1:100 model with 0.40 m² frontal area occupies about 6.8% of the 5.84 m² jet, but about 27% of a 1.5 m² small tunnel. The frontal area and small-tunnel section are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比對兩個以上風洞或兩種試驗條件的壓力係數分布，針對差異說明原因（阻塞、雷諾數、紊流強度、模型粗糙度）；把最不利吸力區對應到蓋板與扣件的分區設計，並以結構模型確認肋拱在最不利風壓分布下仍保持接縫受壓。~Compare pressure-coefficient distributions from at least two tunnels or test conditions and explain differences (blockage, Reynolds number, turbulence intensity, model roughness); map the worst suction zones onto zoned design of lids and fixings, and confirm in the structural model that ribs keep their joints in compression under the most adverse pressure distribution.
units.failure: 只採用單一小風洞的結果，可能因阻塞效應高估吸力而過度設計，也可能因紊流條件不對而低估脊線附近的峰值；若把平均壓力當作設計值、忽略陣風峰值，蓋板扣件會在反覆吸力下逐漸鬆動。~Relying on a single small tunnel may overestimate suction through blockage and over-design, or underestimate ridge peaks through wrong turbulence; taking mean pressure as the design value and ignoring gust peaks lets lid fixings loosen gradually under repeated suction.
units.misconception: 屋頂受風主要是迎風面的正壓，背風面不重要。~Wind on a roof is mainly positive pressure on the windward face; the leeward side is unimportant.
units.practice: 委託風洞試驗時要求報告寫明模型比例、阻塞比、入流紊流剖面與修正方法，並由第二家實驗室或數值模擬抽驗關鍵區；設計者應把風壓分區圖直接交給蓋板與扣件的設計與施工單位。~When commissioning wind-tunnel tests, require the report to state model scale, blockage ratio, approach turbulence profile and correction method, and have key zones spot-checked by a second laboratory or numerical simulation; the designer should hand the pressure-zone map directly to those designing and installing the lids and fixings.

units.anchor: 1:60 壓克力結構模型~1:60 acrylic structural model
units.title: 結構模型試驗與長期變形量測~Structural model tests and long-term deformation
units.mechanism: 1960 年代電腦能力有限，Arup 以 1:60 的白色壓克力模型量測殼片在荷載下的應變與變形，用來檢核手算與程式結果，特別是脊梁、台座與不對稱荷載的反應。真實結構完工後還會因混凝土徐變持續變形，因此設計以最終與瞬時撓度的比值估算長期下垂，並在施工與使用期間量測柱沉陷與殼片位置，確認實際行為落在預測範圍內。~With limited computing power in the 1960s, Arup measured strains and deflections of a 1:60 white acrylic model under load to check hand calculations and program results, especially for the ridge beams, pedestals and asymmetric loading. The real structure keeps deforming after completion through concrete creep, so the design estimated long-term sag with a ratio of final to instantaneous deflection, and column settlement and shell positions were measured during construction and use to confirm that actual behaviour stayed within predictions.
units.model: 公開資料採用最終／瞬時撓度比 2.8。若某肋頂在自重下的瞬時撓度 δ_i = 18 mm，長期撓度 δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm，其中徐變增量約 32 mm；若改用比值 2.0，預測只有 36 mm，會低估約 14 mm 的長期下垂。瞬時撓度與比較用的比值為教學假設。~The published design used a final-to-instantaneous deflection ratio of 2.8. If a rib tip deflects δ_i = 18 mm instantly under self-weight, the long-term deflection is δ_∞ = 2.8×18 ≈ 50 mm, of which about 32 mm is creep; a ratio of 2.0 would predict only 36 mm and underestimate the long-term sag by about 14 mm. The instantaneous deflection and comparison ratio are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 模型試驗先以已知解的簡單荷載校正量測系統，再施加對稱與不對稱荷載，比較模型應變換算到實尺度的內力與分析結果；實結構則在固定測點以精密水準與三維測量建立完工基準，之後定期複測，並與徐變預測曲線比較。~Calibrate the model measurement system first with simple loads of known solution, then apply symmetric and asymmetric loads and compare model strains scaled to full-size forces with the analysis; on the real structure, establish an as-built baseline at fixed targets by precise levelling and three-dimensional survey, then re-measure periodically and compare with the predicted creep curve.
units.failure: 壓克力與混凝土的泊松比與徐變特性不同，若把模型位移按比例放大直接當作長期變形，會漏掉徐變；沒有完工基準的結構，日後發現變形時無法分辨是早期施工偏差還是持續發展的劣化。~Acrylic and concrete differ in Poisson's ratio and creep, so scaling model displacements directly as long-term deformation leaves creep out; without an as-built baseline, deformation found later cannot be separated into early construction deviation and ongoing deterioration.
units.misconception: 縮尺模型的變形按比例放大，就是實際建築的長期變形。~Scaling up a model's deflection gives the real building's long-term deflection.
units.practice: 模型試驗、電腦分析與現場量測三者要寫入同一份驗證矩陣，列出每項檢核的比較對象與允差；完工基準測量的點位、儀器與溫度條件要作為永久紀錄移交業主。~Model tests, computer analysis and field measurements should be entered into one verification matrix listing what each check is compared with and its tolerance; the points, instruments and temperature conditions of the as-built baseline survey should be handed to the owner as a permanent record.

units.anchor: 瓷磚蓋板與青銅扣件~Tile lids and bronze fixings
units.title: 蓋板吸力與扣件耐久設計~Lid suction and durable fixing design
units.mechanism: 屋面約一百零五萬片瓷磚先在地面嵌入預鑄混凝土蓋板，再把蓋板以扣件固定到肋拱上；主殼蓋板為人字形，長約 2.3 m、厚 44.5 mm，背面有 152 mm 高的加勁肋。蓋板自重不足以抵抗風吸力，因此扣件必須承受上拉力，且處在海港鹽霧環境。設計採用鋁青銅托架與磷青銅螺栓，脊梁長螺栓用 K-Monel 或鈦合金，並保守限制側向螺栓的疲勞應力，以 300 年壽命為目標。~About 1.05 million tiles were first set into precast concrete lids on the ground, and the lids were then fixed to the ribs; main-shell lids are chevron-shaped, about 2.3 m long and 44.5 mm thick with 152 mm deep stiffening ribs on the back. Lid self-weight cannot resist wind suction, so the fixings carry uplift, and they sit in harbour salt spray. The design used aluminium-bronze brackets and phosphor-bronze bolts, with K-Monel or titanium for the long ridge bolts, and limited fatigue stress in the lateral bolts conservatively, targeting a 300-year life.
units.model: 扣件設計吸力 3,832 Pa（公開資料）。蓋板自重 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa，加瓷磚約 0.2 kPa，淨上拉 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa。若單片蓋板 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² 由 4 個扣件固定，總上拉約 7.1 kN、每個約 1.8 kN。瓷磚重、蓋板寬度與扣件數為教學假設。~Fixings were designed for suction up to 3,832 Pa (published data). Lid self-weight is 0.0445 m × 24 kN/m³ ≈ 1.07 kPa, plus about 0.2 kPa of tiles, leaving a net uplift of 3.83 − 1.07 − 0.2 ≈ 2.56 kPa. A lid of 2.3 m × 1.2 m = 2.76 m² held by 4 fixings carries a total uplift of about 7.1 kN, about 1.8 kN each. Tile weight, lid width and fixing count are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 扣件材料以成分與機械性質證明驗收，抽樣做拉拔試驗並評估鹽霧與電偶腐蝕；使用期間以目視與敲擊檢查瓷磚空鼓與蓋板接縫密封，並定期取出代表性扣件檢查腐蝕與螺紋狀態，與原設計的疲勞與耐蝕假設比較。~Accept fixing materials by composition and mechanical-property certificates and sample them for pull-out tests and salt-spray and galvanic-corrosion assessment; in service, inspect tiles for debonding by visual and tap testing, check lid-joint sealant, and periodically remove representative fixings to examine corrosion and threads against the original fatigue and corrosion assumptions.
units.failure: 不同金屬接觸而沒有隔離時會產生電偶腐蝕，使扣件在看不見的位置斷面減薄；蓋板接縫密封老化讓雨水進入，鹽分在扣件附近濃縮，最後可能造成蓋板鬆動或瓷磚脫落，在人潮密集的廣場上方形成墜物風險。~Dissimilar metals in contact without isolation corrode galvanically and thin fixings where no one can see; ageing lid-joint sealant lets rain in and salt concentrates around the fixings, which can finally loosen lids or drop tiles above a crowded public forecourt, a falling-object hazard.
units.misconception: 混凝土蓋板很重，風吸力不可能把它們掀起。~Concrete lids are heavy enough that wind suction can never lift them.
units.practice: 外覆層扣件的材料、隔離墊與更換方式要在設計時一併決定，並規劃可從屋面或內側到達的檢查路徑；任何更換扣件或瓷磚的工作，都應先由結構工程師確認臨時固定與吸力分區，再由業主保存部門核准。~Decide cladding-fixing materials, isolation washers and replacement method at design stage and plan inspection access from the roof surface or inside; any replacement of fixings or tiles should first have temporary restraint and suction zoning confirmed by the structural engineer and then be approved by the owner's conservation team.

units.anchor: 遺產保存與檢測紀錄~Heritage and inspection records
units.title: 世界遺產的耐久維護與交接~Durability, maintenance and handover of a World Heritage icon
units.mechanism: 雪梨歌劇院 2007 年列入世界遺產，屋殼既是承重結構，也是受保護的文化資產，任何修繕都必須在結構安全與保存原貌之間取得平衡。海港環境中的混凝土面臨碳化與氯離子侵入，預力鋼絞線與扣件是最關鍵卻最難直接看見的元件，因此維護策略依賴長期檢測紀錄、非破壞檢測與少量取樣。原始設計資料、張拉與灌漿紀錄、量測基準與歷次修繕紀錄共同構成這座建築的工程身分證。~Listed as World Heritage in 2007, the Sydney Opera House shells are both load-bearing structure and protected cultural fabric, so every repair must balance structural safety against conservation of the original. Concrete in a harbour environment faces carbonation and chloride ingress, and the prestressing strand and fixings are the most critical yet least visible components, so maintenance relies on long-term inspection records, non-destructive testing and minimal sampling. Original design data, stressing and grouting records, survey baselines and every past repair together form the building's engineering identity card.
units.model: 碳化深度 x = k·√t。取 k = 2 mm/√年，50 年後 x = 2×√50 ≈ 14 mm，碳化前緣到達 30 mm 保護層約需 (30/2)² = 225 年；若局部裂縫或密封失效使 k 增為 4 mm/√年，50 年就到 28 mm，約 56 年即到達鋼筋。k 值與保護層厚度為教學假設。~Carbonation depth x = k·√t. With k = 2 mm/√year, x = 2×√50 ≈ 14 mm after 50 years, and the front reaches 30 mm cover in about (30/2)² = 225 years; if local cracking or failed sealant raises k to 4 mm/√year, x reaches 28 mm at 50 years and the reinforcement in about 56 years. The k values and cover thickness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以保護層測定儀與酚酞試驗抽查碳化深度、以氯離子剖面取樣評估海鹽侵入，並以半電池電位或電阻率掃描找出鋼筋腐蝕熱點；所有取樣位置須事先經保存顧問核可並盡量選在不顯眼處，檢測結果與歷次紀錄放在同一資料庫比較趨勢。~Spot-check carbonation depth with cover meters and phenolphthalein tests, sample chloride profiles for sea-salt ingress, and scan half-cell potential or resistivity to locate reinforcement-corrosion hot spots; every sampling location must be approved beforehand by the conservation adviser and kept inconspicuous where possible, with results stored in one database with earlier records to compare trends.
units.failure: 只做外觀修補而不追查原因，碳化或氯離子造成的鋼筋腐蝕會在修補邊緣繼續發展，形成所謂環狀陽極效應，修補處一再剝落；不了解預力與扣件的原始設計就更換材料，也可能引入新的電偶腐蝕或改變荷載路徑。~Cosmetic patching without tracking causes lets carbonation- or chloride-driven corrosion continue at patch edges, the incipient-anode effect, so repairs spall again and again; replacing materials without understanding the original prestress and fixing design can introduce new galvanic corrosion or alter the load path.
units.misconception: 列入世界遺產的建築不能做任何結構修繕，只能保持原樣。~A World Heritage building may not receive any structural repair and must be left exactly as it is.
units.practice: 交接與資產管理文件應包含原始計算與 Arup 1973 年公開回顧、張拉與灌漿紀錄、完工量測基準、風壓分區、扣件材料表、檢測週期，以及保存管理計畫的核准流程；任何結構介入都要先經結構工程師評估，再依保存程序取得許可。~Handover and asset-management records should contain the original calculations and Arup's 1973 published review, stressing and grouting records, as-built survey baselines, wind-pressure zoning, fixing-material schedules, inspection intervals and the approval route under the conservation management plan; every structural intervention must be assessed by the structural engineer and then approved through the conservation procedure.

example: 設計練習：檢核一處肋段接縫在風載下是否仍保持受壓。接縫面積 A = 0.90 m²、斷面模數 Z = 0.15 m³，以 7 根 15.2 mm 鋼絞線預壓，每根 140 mm²、有效應力 1,200 MPa：P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN，σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa。風吸力在該接縫造成彎矩 M = 0.12 MN·m，σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa。保守忽略自重軸壓，最小應力 σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0，接縫保持閉合。若長期損失使有效應力降到 1,000 MPa（σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa），同時風洞修正使彎矩增為 1.5 倍（σ_M = 1.20 MPa），σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa，接縫邊緣轉為受拉而可能張開，需要增加預力或重新分區。所有數值為教學假設，不代表雪梨歌劇院的設計值。~Design exercise: check whether a rib-segment joint stays in compression under wind. The joint has area A = 0.90 m² and section modulus Z = 0.15 m³ and is stressed by seven 15.2 mm strands of 140 mm² at an effective stress of 1,200 MPa: P = 7×140×1,200 N ≈ 1.18 MN and σ_P = P/A = 1.18/0.90 ≈ 1.31 MPa. Wind suction causes a joint moment M = 0.12 MN·m, so σ_M = M/Z = 0.12/0.15 = 0.80 MPa. Conservatively ignoring self-weight compression, σ_min = 1.31 − 0.80 = 0.51 MPa > 0 and the joint stays closed. If long-term losses lower the effective stress to 1,000 MPa (σ_P ≈ 1.09 MPa) while a wind-tunnel correction raises the moment by 1.5 times (σ_M = 1.20 MPa), σ_min = 1.09 − 1.20 = −0.11 MPa, the joint edge goes into tension and may open, calling for more prestress or re-zoning. All values are teaching assumptions, not the design values of the Sydney Opera House.
history: 丹麥建築師烏戎在 1957 年贏得雪梨歌劇院國際競圖，Ove Arup & Partners 隨即擔任結構顧問，但帆形屋殼缺乏可計算的幾何，經過多年試算才在 1961 年前後採用以單一球面為母體的預鑄肋拱方案。承包商 Hornibrook 在現場預鑄肋段與瓷磚蓋板，以可伸縮的鋼構架設拱、塔吊與環氧膠結加後拉預力完成屋殼，並以電腦檢核架設程序；風洞試驗與壓克力結構模型也在此案中被大規模使用。建築於 1973 年開幕，2007 年列入世界遺產。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Danish architect Jørn Utzon won the Sydney Opera House international competition in 1957 and Ove Arup & Partners became structural engineers, but the sail-like shells lacked a computable geometry and only around 1961, after years of trial schemes, was the precast rib-arch solution based on a single sphere adopted. The contractor Hornibrook precast rib segments and tile lids on site and built the shells with telescopic steel erection arches, tower cranes and epoxy joints with post-tensioning, checking the erection procedure by computer; wind-tunnel tests and acrylic structural models were also used extensively. The building opened in 1973 and was inscribed as World Heritage in 2007. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 屋頂由 2,194 塊預鑄混凝土構件組成，單塊最重約 15 噸~The roof consists of 2,194 precast concrete sections, each weighing up to about 15 tons
所有主殼外表面取自半徑約 75 m 的同一球面~All main shell surfaces are taken from one sphere of about 75 m radius

最長肋拱每半邊由 12 個標準段加 1 個頂段組成，弧長約 64 m；標準段長約 4.6 m、重約 10 t~The longest rib has 12 standard segments plus a top segment per half, an arc of about 64 m; a standard segment is about 4.6 m long and weighs about 10 t
最高殼頂約高出海平面 67 m（221 ft）~The highest shell rises about 67 m (221 ft) above sea level
屋殼以後拉預力鋼索串接，公開資料記載鋼索總長約 350 km~The shells are tied together by post-tensioned steel cable, about 350 km in total according to public sources
約 1,056,006 片瓷磚鋪設於 4,253 片預鑄蓋板上~About 1,056,006 tiles are set on 4,253 precast tile lids
設計風速極限狀態約 161 km/h，背風脊最大吸力約為停滯壓力的 3.5 倍~The design wind limit state was about 161 km/h, with maximum leeward ridge suction about 3.5 times stagnation pressure
肋段環氧接縫厚度約 0.8 至 3 mm~Epoxy joints between rib segments are about 0.8 to 3 mm thick
1973 年 10 月開幕，2007 年列入世界遺產~Opened in October 1973 and inscribed as World Heritage in 2007

雪梨歌劇院於 10 月 20 日開幕~The Sydney Opera House opens on 20 October
